candidates.formal_type:
∀ {n : Nat} {adj : Matrix.{0, 0, 0} (Fin n) (Fin n) Int},
  Etingof.IsDynkinDiagram n adj →
    ∀ {k : Type u_1} [inst : Field.{u_1} k] {Q : Quiver.{0, 0} (Fin n)},
      Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{0} Q adj →
        ∀ [∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b)]
          (ρ : Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} k (Fin n))
          [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Free.{u_1, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} ρ v)]
          [∀ (v : Fin n), Module.Finite.{u_1, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} ρ v)],
          Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} ρ →
            Exists.{1} fun vertices =>
              Exists.{1} fun p =>
                And
                  (Eq.{1}
                    (Etingof.iteratedSimpleReflection n (Etingof.cartanMatrix n adj) vertices fun v =>
                      Nat.cast.{0} (Module.finrank.{u_1, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} ρ v)))
                    (Etingof.simpleRoot n p))
                  (Exists.{2} fun Q_end =>
                    And (Etingof.IsOrientationOf.{0} Q_end adj)
                      (And (∀ (a b : Fin n), Subsingleton.{1} (Quiver.Hom.{0, 0} a b))
                        (Exists.{max 2 (u_1 + 1)} fun W =>
                          And
                            (∀ (v : Fin n),
                              Module.Free.{u_1, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} W v))
                            (And
                              (∀ (v : Fin n),
                                Module.Finite.{u_1, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} W v))
                              (And (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.IsIndecomposable.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} W)
                                (∀ (v : Fin n),
                                  Eq.{1}
                                    (Nat.cast.{0}
                                      (Module.finrank.{u_1, 0} k (Etingof.QuiverRepresentation.obj.{u_1, 0, 0, 0} W v)))
                                    (Etingof.simpleRoot n p v)))))))

source_text: For an indecomposable representation, the corresponding categorical reflection sequence terminates in an indecomposable representation with simple-root dimension vector.
